The camera wearer’s hands and lower legs are visible beside a tractor at very close range. As the view turns right, several unusually large cabbages appear on the rural road—the nearest only a few steps away and partly in the wearer’s path. Person J is not clearly visible in this downward-facing strip, and there are no cones, signs, or workers indicating a road-work zone. The tractor and prominent oversized vegetables instead suggest an agricultural display, making it appropriate to show J the prize-winning produce.
